intent: Two independently generated new images from scratch; old cat/tiger images were not edit targets.

cat.prompt: Create a completely NEW original square transparent PNG UI bead icon from scratch, NOT an edit or reconstruction of any existing cat picture. Asset: small-tiger category represented by a mature domestic CAT face, for a baccarat bead-road board, readable at only 32–61 pixels. Exactly one circular medallion, front view, centred, diameter 96% of canvas, genuinely transparent outside the circle, no cast shadow outside. Inside: rich ruby-red enamel/gem disc, soft brighter upper-left and deep wine-red lower-right, with one thin polished champagne-gold beveled circular rim. In the centre a large sculpted GOLD domestic CAT FACE with pointed upright ears, occupying about 80% of the disc width and height. Face only, no body or neck. Clear strong silhouette, large distinct almond eyes with deep warm-dark pupils, clearly separated small nose, short muzzle and broad cheeks. Calm mature cat, not kitten, not a tiger. Material is elegant smooth satin gold bas-relief, softly beveled broad planes and precise bright edges, subtle dark bronze recesses and restrained dimensional shadows. It must match a premium gold numeral 7 mounted on a smooth blue/purple gem disc: simple bold polished gold relief, clean color gradients, not a detailed ornate coin. Put the visual emphasis on an immediately recognisable face at tiny size: simplify fur into very few broad sculptural shapes, keep eye/nose contrast clear, do not engrave dozens of hair lines. Soft upper-left studio lighting. No text, no numbers, no labels, no decorative symbols, no crown, no sparkles, no halo dots, no extra rings, no background scene. Clean finished production game-interface artwork.

tiger.prompt: Create a completely NEW original square transparent PNG bead-board UI icon from scratch. Exactly ONE tiger-face circular medallion, not a sheet, no cat, no 7. Must form a consistent premium game icon set with a smooth gold numeral 7 on polished blue/purple enamel and a large sculpted gold cat on ruby enamel. Composition: perfectly front-facing, centered, symmetric circular medallion occupies 96% of canvas with genuine transparency outside. A single thin polished champagne-gold beveled rim; inside, a rich AMBER-GOLD enamel/gem disc, yellow-gold upper-left gradient to deeper warm amber at lower-right, smooth and uncluttered. Subject is a mature TIGER FACE in sculpted satin gold bas-relief, very large, filling 80–84% of inner disc width and height; face only, no neck/body, round ears, wide forehead, broad tiger nose and clearly defined muzzle. This must read unmistakeably as a TIGER at 32–61 pixels: only a few BOLD deep dark-bronze tiger stripes around forehead and cheeks, crisp large almond eyes with dark recessed pupils, strong clean nose and mouth, well-separated cheeks. Use the dark bronze stripes and subtle contour to separate golden face from amber backing; do NOT make a low-contrast gold-on-gold blur. Calm powerful expression, closed mouth, not snarling, not cartoon kitten. Polished broad raised gold shapes, softened bevel highlights, clear dimensional shadow in recesses, same upper-left studio lighting as gold 7 badges. Simplify fur into a few broad sculptural shapes; no intricate engraved hair or clutter. Both eyes must be horizontally level, approximately 36% and 64% across canvas at 46% canvas height, for existing subtle eye glows to align. No text, no number, no label, no crown, no stones, no sparkles, no glowing dots baked into artwork, no halos outside the thin rim, no decorative border patterns, no scene background, no perspective tilt. A single clean production-quality icon.
